latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
This release keeps scan results consistent when the host is under heavy CPU or memory load: Oobee now waits for pages to finish hydrating before running the axe scan, and only lowers concurrency on HTTP 403/429 responses, CPU starvation or memory pressure. Long scans of rate-limited sites no longer stall for hours. It fixes a sitemap-discovery bug where non-standard sitemaps could yield zero scanned pages, adds a three-provider family-DNS failover (`FAMILY_DNS`) with proxy-aware SSRF checks, and lets the report page title/URL be customised. It also includes several rounds of security hardening in both Oobee and the desktop app, plus dependency updates (including `axios` 1.20.0 and `source-map-js` 1.2.2, which fixes CVE-2026-93749).

#### Improvements
* fix: stabilise axe results under CPU contention and stop multi-hour 403/429 stalls by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/879
* fix: non-standard sitemap fallback regex was line-anchored, missing embedded URLs by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/901
* feat: fail over family DNS across three providers (FAMILY_DNS) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/867
* Provide OOBEE_REPORT_PAGE_TITLE and OOBEE_REPORT_PAGE_URL as ENV value to customize title and url by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/898
* feat(page-capture): record element geometry and pseudo-element styles by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/868
* Updating Inspect preset integrations by @Sachin-Gamage in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/862
* Add log() needed for dismissing custom flow overlay scan interface by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/874

#### Fixes
* fix(mac): don't abort installer on xattr quarantine-removal errors by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/882
* fix(report): resolve SAFE_HREF_SCHEMES redeclaration blanking page counts by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/871
* fix(report): show custom-flow page screenshots in About modal by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/880
* fix(report): escape U+2028/U+2029 in itemsStore JSONL by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/881
* fix(url-check): report server HTTP status instead of generic system error by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/872
* fix(updater): follow 302 redirects when fetching SHA-256 sidecar on macOS by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/288
* fix: scope userData write allowlist to renderer-supplied payloads by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/294

#### Security
* security: harden update pipeline, TLS, XSS, IPC by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/285
* security: pin CI actions, verify downloaded artifacts, harden release-notes sanitizer by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/289
* security: parse release-notes HTML inertly and close sanitizer quote-abut bypass by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/292
* fix(security): make connected-address SSRF checks work behind proxies (FAMILY_DNS, CF Worker, Crawlee) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/897
* fix(security): block SSRF via connectivity-check redirects, scanCustomFlow URL scheme allowlist and server-side PDF downloads (asgard-0001, 0002, 0004) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/886, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/887, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/889
* fix(security): contain Safe Browsing zip extraction and remove TOCTOU (asgard-0003) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/888
* fix(security): bound page capture, Family DoH cache, text and PDF page range (asgard-0005, 0006, 0009, 0011) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/890, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/891, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/893, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/894
* fix(security): asgard 2026-10-09 findings (0001-0016) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/896
* security: address asgard cybersec and rescan findings by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/854, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/856, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/858, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/859, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/864, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/865

#### Dependencies
* chore(deps): bump axios from 1.19.0 to 1.20.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/299
* chore(deps): bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/298
* chore(deps): bump ip-address from 10.5.0 to 10.7.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/295
* chore(deps-dev): bump electron from 43.4.1 to 43.5.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/296
* chore(deps-dev): bump undici, brace-expansion, shell-quote, compression, proxy-addr, js-yaml, svgo by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/304, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/303, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/302, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/301, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/300, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/291, https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/290

#### Version bumps
